ownerReports.check: Erase your course on the phone, once offline, and see it gone from the backup
ownerReports.summary: Steps 1-9 passed with the phone and the PC on one account. Online: the erase question named the backup and what the provider's backups keep; Elimina tutto opened Crea il corso; the PC dropped the course by itself, without a reload; a new course with one student reached the PC by itself. All almost immediate. Offline (airplane mode): the question said 'appena c'è connessione', the phone opened Crea il corso without signal, the PC kept the course until the phone reconnected, then dropped it in under 2 seconds without a reload, and after a later reload it stayed gone. Step 10 (optional, Azzera tutti i dati locali) skipped by the owner.
ownerReports.device: Motorola Edge 60 (the owner's phone in earlier reports; not restated)
